fields.statement: At 243aac07 I read the diff. DaemonStatusResponse gains live, starting (always present now) and max. daemonRunsHeld sums non-interrupted runs and unjournaled starts over the status's runs and each project's part. Human prints 'runs: <live>/<max> live, <n> starting'. The Daemon app subtitle and the web daemon panel show the same line, and web Slots = live + starting. Health takes the summed counts instead of adding each project's starts a second time. daemon-status.txtar asserts the human line '^runs: [0-9]+/3 live, [0-9]+ starting$' and the JSON fields live, starting and max=3. daemonapp TestShowsRunsAgainstCap (a fake status with 2 live, 1 starting, max 4) gives 'runs: 2/4 live, 1 starting'. Web TestOverviewReadsDaemonFromRepo (1 running, 1 interrupted, Starting 1, max 4) renders 'runs: 2/4 live, 1 starting' and 3 of 4 slots. With RHIZA_ROOT unset and GOTMPDIR outside the repo, these passed: go test -count=1 -trimpath ./internal/tui/daemonapp/... ./internal/web/...; go test -count=1 -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-status|daemon-status-projects|describe-golden|health.*)$' (daemon-status, daemon-status-projects, describe-golden, health, health-runs-cap, health-projects and health-machine-part all PASS); go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Health|DaemonStatus|WebDaemon'.
